description: This file defines a base class for unit testing the WebAudioPlayer component, including setup and teardown methods, mock expectations, and helper functions for testing buffer management and timer behavior.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing setup, teardown, and helper functions for unit testing WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects and configuration parameters.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Sets up expectations and creates an instance of WebAudioPlayerServerInternal.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys the WebAudioPlayer instance, unmapping resources.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTask
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueueTask to execute immediately.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueueTaskAndWait to execute immediately.

methods.name: getBufferAvailableSuccess
methods.description: Checks that getBufferAvailable returns expected frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: expectWriteStoredFrames
methods.description: Sets expectation for writing stored frames to the buffer.

methods.name: expectWriteNewFrames
methods.description: Sets expectation for writing new frames to the buffer.

methods.name: expectStartTimer
methods.description: Sets expectation for starting a timer.

methods.name: expectCancelTimer
methods.description: Sets expectation for canceling a timer.
